headline: Release briefs now stay on shared narrative contract
before_state: Release narration drifted because each flow used local schema checks.
after_state: Release narration now validates against shared narrative contract helpers.
summary: Release narration now enforces shared taxonomy and extension boundaries, so contract drift is caught before publication.
conceptual_shift: Narration validation moved from local checks to a shared narrative-document contract.
why_it_matters: Teams can trust Daily Lens and release reports to speak the same metadata language rather than diverging.
proof_points: Issue #2511 defined the shared metadata contract.
structural_changes: Release validator now delegates narrative metadata validation to shared contract helpers.
behavioral_shifts: Narrator outputs now fail deterministically when taxonomy or extension keys drift.
implicit_decisions: Taxonomy expansion now requires reviewed code/config changes.

astrochicken.internal_note: Internal context kept off the public summary.
